messages:
Sam: Kicking off a cross-family GPTQ bakeoff for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B. Goal: find recipes with <=1.5% MMLU delta vs FP32 and sane latency on our Dedicated pool.
Anya: +1 — can you add AWQ and int8 baselines too? want FP8 comparisons if available.
Sam: yes AWQ-8, GPTQ-4, INT8, and FP8 where supported. baseline = FP32.
Mitra: datasets we should run: MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag quick sweep, TruthfulQA low/medium. agree?
Sam: yep those. add a small in-house promptset for hallucination checks.
Kai: allocation request: need 8 A100s for parallel runs for 48h. tagging Dedicated pool 'bake-gptq-1965'.
Frank: logging note: please use the eval harness config version v3 so metrics are comparable.
Sam: command I'm running (local):
```bash
./bakeoff/run.sh --models llama2-13b,mistral-7b,qwen-7b \
  --recipes gptq-4,awq-8,int8,fp8 \
  --datasets mmlu,gsm8k,hellaswag,truthfulqa,internal_prompts \
  --seed 42 --harness v3 --outdir /mnt/bakeoffs/1965432100
```
Anya: leaving a note: ensure quant params include per-channel scaling and clipped activations for GPTQ runs.
Mitra: will also capture KV cache memory and peak GPU memory traces for each run.
Maria: can we get latency p50/p95 on T4 and A100? we need deployment profiles for Dedicated and Private.
Sam: yes. deploy-bot will collect latency traces once model artifacts are staged.
deploy-bot: artifact build started for llama2-13b:gptq-4bit @ build-1965432112. will post perf when ready.
eval-bot: first quick snapshot (toy sample, not final):
- Llama2-13B GPTQ-4: MMLU -1.2%, GSM8K -3.4%, Latency A100 +45% vs FP32 (12ms vs 8ms)
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: MMLU -0.9%, GSM8K -2.0%, Latency A100 +38% (9ms vs 6.5ms)
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-4: MMLU -1.8%, GSM8K -4.1%, Latency A100 +52% (14ms vs 9ms)
Anya: interesting that Mistral holds up better. could be operator ordering or layernorm sensitivity.
Mitra: attached quick config diff: GPTQ uses per-channel quant, blocksize=128 by default. AWQ-8 uses asymmetric scale, per-tensor fallback on small dims.
Sam: someone run AWQ-8 v GPTQ-4 tradeoff sweep on Mistral with blocksize 64 -> want latency vs accuracy curve.
Frank: I can run that overnight and post a short CSV.
Maria: cost estimates request: for Dedicated (8xA100) what's per-token cost delta if we pick GPTQ-4 vs AWQ-8?
Sam: rough calc: GPTQ-4 reduces model size ~2.7x -> raw GPU throughput improves but kernel overhead increases p99. I'll put a spreadsheet.
Anya: also please validate reranking and instruction-following prompts; some quant recipes regress on instruction-following even if MMLU ok.
Mitra: note: observed a few generation-level regressions on TruthfulQA with Qwen GPTQ-4 sample runs. flagging for deeper eval.
eval-bot: uploading full run artifacts: s3://redwood-bakeoffs/1965432100/ (hash: sha256:ab12...). expect full metrics in 6h.
Sam: plan next steps after full metrics: 1) pick top 2 recipes per family, 2) run A/B on Canary Dedicated route, 3) monitor DLQ for hallucination/regressions, 4) prepare rollout docs.
Kai: will reserve canary slot on prod-dedicated for 24h after step 2.
Frank: pushing a short PR with bake config changes (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/289).
Maria: thanks — once we have p95 latency and cost numbers we can pick default deployment profiles for each family.
Sam: anything else? if not I'll let the jobs run. ping me with failures.
Anya: one last ask: capture tokenization mismatches across families — Qwen tokenization inflated tokens on our promptset. might skew per-token cost.
Sam: good call. added to checklist.
Mitra: noted. I'll include token counts in the final CSV.
deploy-bot: canary slot reserved: prod-dedicated/bake-gptq-1965 -> reserved by Kai until 1965518700.
Sam: thanks everyone, will post final summary when eval-bot finishes. :rocket:
